messages:
maria: Quick sync — ACME just asked for a per-endpoint QoS/reserved-throughput add-on. They want guaranteed RPS per route. Can product + eng decide launch gating?
ajay: Heard back from sales — ACME needs ~100rps for 3 routes, 99th percentile latency SLA, willing to pay a premium monthly.
sarah: We should decide billing model: reserved slots vs burst credits. UI/API work needed either way.
devon: Tech constraints: requires routing-layer changes + reserved pools or token-buckets. Fallback behavior important if reserved pool saturates.
kevin: ops-bot posted current capacity snapshot: pool-west capacity 120k rps, reserved currently ~48k (40%), avg headroom 72k.
ops-bot: pool-west: cap=120000rps, reserved=48000rps, free=72000rps, 95th-util=62% — monitoring/alerts enabled.
maria: Proposed launch gating checklist: 1) billing schema signed-off, 2) API + Console UX implemented & canaried, 3) 7-day SLO telemetry pass in staging, 4) legal T&C clause, 5) runbook for oncall + fallback.
ajay: Pricing suggestion from commercial: $500/month per 100rps reservation per route, 3-month minimum commit. Open to feedback.
sarah: API sketch for review (beta):
```
POST /v1/routes/:id/qos_reservations
{
  "capacity_rps": 100,
  "duration_months": 3,
  "billing_account": "acct_..."
}
```
This creates a reservation object and billing event.
devon: Rollout plan: implement reservation token in routing, canary to dedicated customers in us-west, lagged fallback -> if reserved pool exhausted, requests downgrade to best-effort model + soft-throttle (500ms extra queuing) + emit `qos_fallback` metric.
kevin: Concern: committing capacity for small customers fragments pool. Need guardrail: min reservation = 100rps and a regional cap per org. Also need autoscale knobs.
legal-bot: Draft clause suggestion: "Reserved QoS purchases commit customer to a minimum duration of X months; early termination fees apply to cover provisioned capacity. Provider maintains right to degrade to compatible model variants for safety." Need legal review.
maria: Agree on minimum: 3 months. For launch, require at least one signed pilot (ACME or another customer) and 7-day SLO validation in prod-like env.
ajay: I'll surface $500/100rps + 3mo min to ACME next week. Also confirm whether they want per-route or pooled across their org.
sarah: Dev estimate: Console + API + billing + e2e tests ~ 8 dev-weeks (split across two squads). Evals/telemetry sprint parallel.
devon: On-call/runbook: if `qos_fallback` > 0.5% of requests over 5m, auto-rollback reservation routing and notify support. Need playbook updates.
kevin: Ops task: add metrics `qos_reserved_rps`, `qos_fallback_count`, `qos_fallback_ratio` to per-route dashboards.
maria: Action items: Ajay — confirm ACME pilot commitment; Sarah — open API/Console PRs; Devon — design fallback + canary plan; Kevin — dashboards & capacity guardrails; Legal — draft clause. Target: pilot in 3 weeks.
ajay: Ack, will update after customer call Monday. :thumbsup:
sarah: Putting rough PR checklist in GH issue now.
maria: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for gating decisions.
